name: review-chain
description: QC follow-up chain: one OC session takes the user's QC findings into a queue, spawns worker sessions (one per discussion-type feature, one bundled worker for small non-overlapping fixes) in their own git worktrees, checks file-scope conflicts before work starts, serializes merges, and owns shared files (version, release notes, progress ledger, external trackers). The user talks to workers directly in their tabs/panes; workers claim file scopes themselves via rc-claim.sh and exchange messages through inbox files; receivers subscribe and the inbox-hooks dependency wakes an idle session (Monitor only for tools without hooks; no typing into panes), so the OC can be replaced when its context fills. Uses the tool-neutral agent-orchestrator in tools/.
